---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for the boilerplate
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are proposing.

## Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem this feature would solve, or the motivation behind the request.

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I always have to manually do X when Y happens…")

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you prefer your proposed solution.

## Affected Areas

Select all areas that would be impacted by this change:

- [ ] `bin/setup.sh` (setup script)
- [ ] `functions.php` / `inc/` (PHP modules)
- [ ] `_dev/blocks/` (ACF blocks)
- [ ] `_dev/` (Webpack / SCSS / JS)
- [ ] `theme.json` / `admin-caps.json` (FSE configuration)
- [ ] `.github/workflows/` (CI/CD workflows)
- [ ] Documentation / README
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
